Hi everyone,

My husband and I are leaving Israel before completing the  process. We’re married, and he currently holds an A/5 visa. Since we’re moving to another country, we need to close our file with the Ministry of Interior.

Our appointment isn’t until February, but we’d like to notify the Ministry and close everything properl, before we leave (beginning of the November), so he won't have problems coming to visit.

Does anyone know what the process is? Do we need to schedule an appointment\ go in person, or can this be handled by email?

Thank you very much!
